input.value: Walkway in front of policyholder's house
Broken wrist from slip and fall on icy walkway

input.rationale: Third-party child injured on policyholder's premises due to dangerous condition (icy walkway); classic premises liability claim with injury to non-household member.

Pediatric injury (broken wrist in 9-year-old) with ongoing medical bills; likely $2,000–$25,000 range for cast, treatment, possible follow-up orthopedic care, but no indication of permanent damage or multiple victims.

input.claim_summary: Third-party child (age 9) sustained a broken wrist after slipping on ice on policyholder's front walkway during an ice storm last week. Parents are pursuing medical bills. This is a premises liability claim with pediatric injury; covered under POL-1002 with $500k limit and $1k deductible.
